name: Divine Omen
source:
Avan's fortitude wanes each day as the voice grows louder, crueler, impossible to drown. The nightmares he'd wished away only become more vivid. More sinister. More real. Accompany Avan on a journey to absolve himself of his own sins - to prove to the people of Lamonte that he's more than the killer they knew...so much more.

The land has grown sick. Echoes lurk beyond the city walls. Remorse weighs heavy on the young doctor's mind, but only vengeance seeps from his scarred palm. Executioner...the choice is yours alone. Will you turn your back on fate or heed its call?


[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2997900/Divine_Omen/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
随着声音变得越来越大、越来越残酷、难以被淹没，艾文的毅力一天比一天减弱。他希望摆脱的噩梦只会变得更加生动。更加险恶。更真实。陪伴埃文踏上洗清自己罪孽的旅程 - 向拉蒙特人民证明他不仅仅是他们所认识的杀手……更多。

这片土地已经生病了。回声潜伏在城墙之外。悔恨沉重地压在年轻医生的心头，但他伤痕累累的手掌中却流露出复仇的情绪。刽子手……选择权在于你。你会拒绝命运还是听从它的召唤？


[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2997900/Divine_Omen/]Steam[/url]]
